summary: First-finish smoke tests for GlobServ B2B export site. Backend endpoints (public + auth + admin) verified via curl; frontend home + inquiry submission + product detail panel + admin login + dashboard tabs verified via Playwright. All core flows green.
passed: GET /api/products -> 6 seeded products (Spirulina, Aloe Vera, Khus (Vetiver) Roots, Basmati 1121 Rice, Chilli, Turmeric)
GET /api/settings -> whatsapp_number, business_email, business_tagline, address present
POST /api/auth/login (admin creds) -> 200, user object + bearer token + access_token httpOnly cookie set
GET /api/auth/me without cookie -> 401; with cookie -> admin user
GET /api/admin/inquiries without auth -> 401; with cookie -> list returned (2 items)
PUT /api/admin/settings with full body -> 200; GET /api/settings reflects updated tagline
Home page loads with navbar, hero, products, inquiry form, footer
Inquiry form submission (input-name, input-email, input-message, submit-inquiry) shows success toast: 'Enquiry received - we will respond within 24 hours.'
/admin unauthenticated shows admin-login-form; login with admin credentials reveals admin-tab-inquiries, admin-tab-products, admin-tab-settings
Submitted 'QA Bot' inquiry appears in admin dashboard Inquiries tab after login

failed.issue: Endpoint requires ALL settings fields (whatsapp_number, business_email, business_tagline, address) in request body; partial updates return 422. Not a bug per Pydantic schema, but worth noting for admin UI - Settings tab must send full object.
failed.evidence: PUT with only {business_tagline: ...} -> 422 'Field required' for whatsapp_number, etc. Full body -> 200.

action_items: Confirm Admin Settings tab in frontend submits the complete settings object (all 4 fields) on save to avoid 422s. Not verified end-to-end in this pass.
